when_used: A person aggrieved by a caution applies to the Land Registrar to remove it, setting out the grounds and attaching the documents that support them.

body_text.text: The Applicant HEREBY APPLIES to remove the Caution registered in Entry Number(s) {{entry_numbers}} on the Encumbrances Section of the Register.
The grounds for the application are as follows:-
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this application for removal of caution has been duly executed this......................…. day of……………………….. 20………

foot_notes: Give full names ID/Passport No.; PIN and Address

custom_fields.name: caution_date
custom_fields.label: Date of the Caution
custom_fields.prompt: The date of the caution the application seeks to remove

custom_fields.name: applicant_pin
custom_fields.label: PIN of the Applicant
custom_fields.prompt: Personal Identification Number of the applicant

custom_fields.name: proprietor_pin
custom_fields.label: PIN of the Proprietor
custom_fields.prompt: Personal Identification Number of the registered proprietor

custom_fields.name: proprietor_address
custom_fields.label: Address of the Proprietor
custom_fields.prompt: Postal address of the registered proprietor

custom_fields.name: entry_numbers
custom_fields.label: Entry number of the Caution
custom_fields.prompt: The entry number or numbers of the caution in the Encumbrances Section of the register

custom_fields.name: grounds
custom_fields.label: Grounds for the application
custom_fields.prompt: The grounds for removing the caution, one ground per line
